mapper.select: select b.no, b.title, b.content, m.id, date_format(b.reg_date, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s") as reg_date, b.view_cnt from board b left outer join member m on b.member_id = m.member_id where title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')

select b.no, b.title, b.content, m.id as writer, date_format(b.reg_date, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s") as reg_date, b.view_cnt from board b left outer join member m on b.member_id = m.member_id where b.no = #{no}
